proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
proposed.text: In episode 89, Elena is abducted with Coulson's team and carried to 2091, where she and Mack are held captive by the Kree.

changes.evidence: Season 5 'Orientation' (episodes 89-90): an unknown group seizes Coulson, May, Daisy, Simmons, Mack and Yo-Yo and takes them to a space station; Mack and Yo-Yo are held captive by the Kree. She is not freed until the team returns in episode 98. The file has no record of it.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 110, in 2091, Enoch seems to die getting the team home, while his present self still travels in space with Fitz.

proposed.text: In episode 98, in 2091, Enoch seems to die getting the team home, while his present self still travels in space with Fitz.

changes.evidence: Future Enoch's apparent death happens in season 5 episode 10 'Past Life' (episode 98): Deke saves Enoch and fixes the machine 'seemingly at the cost of both of their lives, as the team returns to the present'. Episode 110 ('The End') only mentions the present Fitz in stasis aboard Enoch's ship.

now.title: Daredevil S3
now.text: In episode 11, Lantom shelters the injured Matt and later Karen, and is killed by Dex while shielding her at Clinton Church.

proposed.text: In episode 10, Lantom shelters the injured Matt and later Karen, and is killed by Dex while shielding her at Clinton Church.

changes.evidence: Daredevil season 3 episode 10 'Karen': 'Karen attends a service at Clinton Church when Dex, dressed as Daredevil, arrives and kills Lantom'. Episode 11 'Reunion' picks up after the attack.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 71, Jeffrey Mace becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., hailed as a powered Inhuman.

proposed.text: In episode 67, Jeffrey Mace leads S.H.I.E.L.D. as its new Director, hailed as a powered Inhuman.

changes.evidence: Mace is already Director when season 4 opens: episode 67 'The Ghost' names 'Director Jeffrey Mace', episode 68 shows his 'Inhuman strength', and episode 69 has him publicly announce S.H.I.E.L.D.'s return. Episode 71 'Lockup' is his secret deal with Nadeer, not when he becomes Director.

now.title: Iron Fist S1
now.text: In episode 4, Jeri proves Danny Rand's identity in exchange for a contract with Rand Enterprises.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Jeri proves Danny Rand's identity in exchange for a contract with Rand Enterprises.

changes.evidence: Iron Fist season 1 episode 3 'Rolling Thunder Cannon Punch': Rand meets Hogarth, who promises to reclaim his identity in exchange for a permanent contract with Rand Enterprises, and uses fingerprint evidence to prove it to Joy and Ward. Episode 4 is the Triad attack on Joy.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 37, mercenary Lance Hunter joins Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. on his ex-wife Bobbi's word.

proposed.text: In episode 37, Lance Hunter, the mercenary Coulson has used since Creel killed Hartley's team, agrees to become a permanent S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.

changes.evidence: Hunter was not brought in on Bobbi's word. In season 2 episode 1 (23) he leads mercenaries enlisted by S.H.I.E.L.D. and Creel's attack kills Hartley. In episode 24 Coulson asks him to stay. Morse, his ex-wife, joins only in episode 27, and in episode 37 'One Door Closes' Hunter 'agrees to become a permanent agent'.

now.title: Daredevil S2
now.text: In episode 11, Now at Hogarth, Chao & Benowitz, Marci warns Foggy that Reyes is using Frank's trial to run for mayor and offers him a way in.

proposed.text: In episode 11, Marci, now at Hogarth, Chao & Benowitz, visits Foggy in the hospital after he is shot and offers to set up a meeting with her firm.

changes.evidence: Marci's warning that Reyes wants to become mayor using Frank's trial comes in episode 5 'Kinbaku'. Reyes is killed in episode 10. In episode 11 '.380', Marci visits the wounded Foggy in the hospital and offers to set up a meeting with Hogarth, Chao & Benowitz. As written, the text puts a living Reyes in episode 11.
